**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, T4C).**

What I found in Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment):

- **Vendor walk-away:** §4.1 makes the exit right symmetrical — "terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice" — so HDI can exit during a renewing term, which our playbook does not permit.
- **Our exit is penalized:** §4.2(a) imposes a Termination Payment only on the Company, equal to (trailing 12-month Net Sales − $800,000) ÷ 2. Since fees under §3 are 30% of Net Sales, this exit penalty is uncapped and vastly exceeds even the fallback cap of three months' fees. §4.2(b)–(c) are just mechanics for that payment (and expressly confirm HDI never pays us anything).

Redline (validated ok:true, preferred level):
1. §4.1 — Company may terminate for convenience on **30 days' notice** with refund of prepaid fees; HDI limited to **non-renewal at end of term on 90 days' notice**, with express language that HDI has no mid-term convenience right.
2. §4.2(a) — replaced with a no-termination-payment/no-penalty statement, leaving us liable only for fees accrued before the Termination Date.
3. §4.2(b)–(c) (p0027–p0029) — deleted as inoperative once the Termination Payment is removed.

The comment offers the fallback (exit fee capped at three months' fees) in case HDI pushes back on full deletion.
